# Code Anchors: Roadmap Naming

- `components/commands/nxsx.teach-plan.md` — the planning phase's input: exactly one of an epic number, an initiative number or a search, with more than one refused before anything runs
- `components/skills/nxsx-workbook/SKILL.md` — the workbook verbs' usage list, including resolving a roadmap from an initiative
